detail.title: A kind of vacuum cup component
detail.abstract: The present invention relates to a kind of vacuum cup component, including multiple suckers；Each sucker has sucker head, sucker neck, sucker disk seat, ventilating joint, rubber seal.The small size vacuum suction unit of several sizes of different sizes.According to the design feature of different parts, using different size of small vacuum suction table, periphery is supported with adjustment height, with the mode Clamp blocks that vacuum suction table is clamped on lathe.
assignees: Harbin Aircraft Industry Group Co Ltd

The invention relates to a vacuum suction cup assembly, which comprises a plurality of suction cups; each suction cup has a suction cup head, a suction cup neck, a suction cup seat, a ventilation joint and a rubber sealing ring. Several small vacuum tables of different sizes. According to the structural characteristics of different parts, small vacuum suction tables of different sizes are used, and the surrounding area is supported by adjustable height, and the parts are clamped by clamping the vacuum suction table on the machine tool.
technical field
The invention relates to the field of clamping and fixing, in particular to a vacuum suction cup assembly.
Background technique

In the scientific research and production of aircraft manufacturing, new models are constantly being born, and some parts are continuously improved during the scientific research stage of new models, especially some large-scale mechanically processed frame, beam, and integral web parts. More, large-scale tooling is required in processing, and due to the continuous change of parts, the corresponding large-scale tooling is also constantly changed, and some will even be scrapped, which will cause a lot of waste.
Contents of the invention
purpose of invention

In order to avoid the waste of a large number of tooling changes due to design changes in parts, and to meet the processing needs of new models and new parts, a set of "a vacuum suction cup set" was designed to adapt to the processing of new models and new parts. The purpose of reducing cost and putting into production quickly has been achieved.
Technical solutions
Provide a vacuum suction cup assembly, including a plurality of suction cups;
Each suction cup has a suction cup head 1, a suction cup neck 2, a suction cup seat 3, a ventilation joint 4, and a rubber sealing ring 5;

The ventilation joint 4 is fixedly connected to the sucker neck 2, the upper end of the sucker neck 3 is connected to the sucker head 1, the lower end of the sucker neck 2 is connected to the sucker seat 3, and the sucker seat 3 is compatible with the workbench of the processing machine tool, and can be fixed on the workbench;

The suction cup head 1 is a rectangular block, the upper surface of the rectangular block is a plane, and a mesh ventilation groove is formed, and a sealing groove is formed on the periphery of the plane, and the rubber sealing ring 5 is installed in the sealing groove , the mesh ventilation grooves communicate with each other, and there are ventilation holes at the bottom of the ventilation grooves,
A gas passage is provided in the neck 2 of the suction cup, and the gas passage communicates all the vent holes with the vent connector 4 .
In particular, the shape of the upper surface of the rectangular block of the suction cup head 1 in the suction cup group is either square or rectangular.
In particular, the area of the upper surface of the rectangular block of the suction cup head 1 in the suction cup group includes various sizes.
In particular, the distance between the air grooves of the mesh air grooves of each suction cup is at least 30 mm.

In particular, the suction cup seat 3 has a support rod and a suction cup, and the support rod is a support rod with adjustable length, such as an adjustable positioning telescopic sleeve or a lead screw sleeve, etc., by adjusting the length, the suction cup can be made The height of the head is adjustable to suit parts with different surface shapes.
The specific steps for using the above-mentioned sucker group are as follows:
Step 1. Combine multiple suction cups according to the shape of the adsorption surface of the workpiece to be adsorbed;
Step 2, fixing the arrangement position of the combined suction cup installation combination on the machine tool table;
Step 3, connecting one end of a plurality of hoses 6 to the ventilation joints 4 of the corresponding suction cups;
Step 4, connecting the other ends of the plurality of hoses 6 to the main gas pipeline 7 respectively;
Step 5, ventilate the suction cups from the main gas pipeline 7, check whether the air passages of each suction cup are unobstructed and complete the preparation for pumping;
Step 6: Attach the adsorption surface of the workpiece to be adsorbed on the suction cup, and pump air through the main air pipeline 7 to complete the vacuum adsorption of the workpiece.
technical effect

The machine tool clamps the small vacuum suction table selected according to the structural characteristics of the part through the clamping device, and then absorbs the adsorption surface of the part through small vacuum suction tables of different sizes, and the peripheral part body is supported by adjustable height to realize the processing operation. It overcomes the waste of a large number of changes in tooling due to design changes in parts, reduces problems such as long tooling manufacturing cycles, and improves stability and production efficiency. This standardized vacuum suction cup combination series has the characteristics of modularization and dexterity.
